remarks: A Jewel! Rare opportunity to own a stunning artfully designed modern church w/architectural elements & impeccable attention to detail. Architect firm Gray Organschis transformation is as much a work of art as it is a showcase for it. Massive Venetian chandelier from Murano, a centerpiece of grand main living area w/stunning 20' of vertical wall space & 16' tall windows. White cedar front door, a replica of an admired sushi bar in Japan is a work of art in-and-of itself. Stunning foyer w/S-curved wall. This inspiring home is perfect for a buyer who chooses to own a property unlike anyone else's. Meticulously renovated, restored & rebuilt in 2007. The exterior facade reads as was written 150 years ago w/an interior undeniably outstanding. Superb condo alternative. 3rd bedroom/rec room in LL w/full bath
